The '''Tanta Besh system''' was an uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="gazetteer" /> in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]<ref name="gazetteer-map" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="outersec" /> off the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and slightly coreward of the [[Tanta Aurek system/Legends|Tanta Aurek system]].<ref name="gazetteer-map" /> [[Tanta Besh]], the system's primary star was an unstable blue giant, whose pulses and erratic changes in luminosity were excellent material for diviners all across the sector.<ref name="gazetteer" />
